_comment: The aspects the improvement pass reviews a draft by, loaded at run time via DownloadTemplate (template_name: datasets/article_aspects.json). Adding an aspect is a new entry here plus its prompt file; the graph holds no aspect id, so nothing else changes. A missing, unparsable or empty registry stops the run loudly: without its definitions the improvement pass must not run quietly on nothing.
_comment_prompts: Each prompt is fetched by DownloadTemplate with template_name from this file, so a path here is a repository path relative to agents/n8n/.

aspects.focus: the plot, the arc and the fit to the shape the writer chose
terms, plain language and depth at the row's audience level
